By James Klein, Larta VOX Editor - November 3, 2003

In the future, we won't lose anything. Advances in global positioning system technology allow users to easily pinpoint the location of any object on earth. GPS boards have been reduced to the size of a postage stamp. Soon, we could attach GPS locators to everything we own - cell phones,

briefcases, wallets - and even our children.
